    Quotients by arbitrary sets of idempotents #

    For any set T' of live points, A / ⟨e_v : v ∉ T'⟩ is directed (quotAny), with points T' and an arrow for each nonzero corner. Chains ending at a projective of the quotient lift by pullbacks to chains of the same length ending at a projective of A (chain_lift, ASS IX.5.2), so indecomposable projectives of the quotient are good if those of A are (good_quot).
